dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibiting high-contrast dark exterior perimeters with sharp transitions to lighter interior gradients; geometries range from near-perfect circles to vertically elongated ellipses.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid light-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients, primarily localized along the ventral-lateral margin and clustered near the anterior region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent central macro-annuli form a complex polygonal arrangement characterized by two primary triangular clusters joined by a shared central vertex.
